title: Geographic maps: choropleth, symbols and projections

videos.script: Here is a map of Brazil, every state shaded by how many orders Horta received there. {{map}} São Paulo stands out the most. Then Rio, Minas Gerais and the South. The North is almost empty. {{strong}} What has this map discovered? Mostly that more people live in São Paulo. A map of population would look almost the same. {{population}} Now shade the same states by orders per thousand people. {{rate}} The picture changes. The Federal District leads. Santa Catarina comes second. The question has become how well Horta does in each place, and that is the question a business usually has. {{question}} Maps are the most persuasive charts there are, because a map looks like the world. That makes their mistakes harder to see. {{persuasive}} This lesson covers when a map is the right chart at all, how to shade one honestly, when to use symbols instead, and why the shape of the world on the page is already a choice. {{plan}}
